stats: Unarmed Attacks are Attacks which are performed while Unarmed and use your character's base Unarmed Damage where other Attacks would use the base Damage from a Martial Weapon.
Attacks which can be performed while Unarmed but draw their base damage from other sources, such as skills which use a Shield to attack, are not considered Unarmed Attacks.
